log_file.description: Log file name for the SR-IOV agent. Set to empty string ('') to disable file logging.

log_dir.description: Directory where log files will be stored. Ensure the directory exists and is writable by the agent user.

log_format.description: Python logging format string used for log messages.

log_date_format.description: Date/time format used in log timestamps.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging (INFO level). If set to false, defaults to WARNING.

debug.description: Enable debug-level logging (very verbose). Should be disabled in production unless troubleshooting.

physical_device_mappings.description: List of mappings from logical physical networks to host network devices (e.g., 'physnet1:ens3f0'). Each entry maps a network name to a PCI device (e.g., interface or SR-IOV VF pool device).

physical_network.description: Logical name of the physical network (must match network provider or tenant network config).

device_name.description: Name of the host device (e.g., 'ens3f0') or PCI device alias used for this physical network.

allowed_physical_networks.description: List of allowed physical network names (e.g., ['default', 'external']). If empty, all networks are allowed. Use to restrict which physical networks the agent handles.

polling_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between polling for SR-IOV device status changes. Lower values increase responsiveness but CPU usage.

enable_l2_pop.description: Enable L2 population support (requires ML2 plugin with L2-pop mechanism driver). Reduces broadcast traffic and improves scale.

enable_dynamic_segmentation.description: Enable dynamic VLAN segmentation support (used with VLAN provider networks).

enable_security_group.description: Enable security groups (firewall rules applied per port). Required if tenant workloads use security groups.

firewall_driver.description: Firewall driver to use: iptables_hybrid (default), iptables, or ovs. 'iptables_hybrid' combines OVS for switching with Linux iptables for security rules.

ip_tables_drop_log.description: Enable logging of dropped packets by iptables (for debugging security groups). Only effective with iptables-based firewall drivers.
